decisions.reason: The transactional email service is the firm's flagship and fits its push toward cloud enterprise messaging, so it will be kept even though the website did not show it in 2020-2021.

Email-to-fax and fax-to-email conversion still serves regulated customers and costs little to run on existing infrastructure, though its absence from the website in 2020-2021 and the decline of fax raise the risk of withdrawal.

The fax delivery optimization feature is cheap to maintain within the fax business, but long-term fax decline and its low visibility make it the most likely candidate for being merged into the base service.
Multi-engine virus scanning remains a core part of the secure email offering that customers expect, so it is likely to stay, possibly rebranded within a broader security bundle.
